# Joshua Driver

> Joshua Driver is the founder & CEO of Selflessly and an AI operations advisor and
> keynote speaker based in Indianapolis, Indiana. He helps small teams and
> purpose-driven organizations adopt practical AI — guardrails first. His work
> rebuilding Selflessly around an AI agent was featured in the Indianapolis
> Business Journal.

## Who he is

- Name: Joshua Driver (also goes by Josh Driver)
- Role: Founder & CEO of Selflessly
- Location: Indianapolis, IN, USA
- Focus: AI operations advisory and keynote speaking for small teams and
  purpose-driven organizations
- Background: 10+ years at the intersection of technology and social impact.
  Founded Selflessly (a B-Corp workplace-giving and volunteering SaaS platform,
  launched 2020). Previously led innovation teams at NIC Inc. Created Open for
  Service (CNN and BBC coverage) and serves on Indianapolis's Equal Opportunity
  Advisory Board.
- As featured in: Indianapolis Business Journal — "Founder rebuilds software
  platform with AI agent at the core"
  (https://www.ibj.com/articles/founder-rebuilds-software-platform-with-ai-agent-at-the-core)

## What Selflessly is

Selflessly is a workplace-giving, volunteering, and corporate social
responsibility (CSR) software platform. It launched in 2020. Joshua Driver is
its founder and CEO. Website: https://selflessly.io

## Speaking topics (three signature talks)

1. "I Rebuilt My Company Around an AI Agent — What Actually Works" — a field
   report on rebuilding a company around an AI agent: what broke, what surprised
   the team, and the guardrails that make AI safe to trust.
2. "AI for the Rest of Us: Small Teams, Real Guardrails" — the playbook for
   companies without an AI department: find where AI genuinely fits, start
   without betting the business, and build trust one task at a time.
3. "ADHD, AI, and the Art of Staying Out of Your Own Way" — designing systems
   around how your brain actually works; productivity without shame, and why the
   future of work may fit neurodivergent minds better than the past did.

## Advisory

AI Operations Advisory Session — find where AI genuinely fits an organization,
design the guardrails, and build routines the team will actually use. Also
available for technology strategy, fractional technology leadership, and
B-Corp / benefit corporation guidance.
